div.head: 121 — v — VII. — We have become as they that rejoice.

div.ab:
Whenever we [lift up the thoughts of our mind toward thee, God-bearer and Virgin Mary, and consider the only Son and the Word of the invisible Father; who received a body from the descent of the Holy Spirit and from thee in pure fashion and [hypostatically and without variation partook of the nature of our manhood; who was attacked before by the evil one because of sin, and was rejected and made an alien from the Father, and the same again similarly raised us with him and lifted us up together and made us sit with him in glory [in heaven, we repeat to thee, holy mother who [knewest not copulation, the expressions of the patriarch Jacob, This is the place of God; and this is the gate of heaven; through which we who had been cast
down beneath have been raised up on high. And therefore, also when we offer up our prayers in faith through thee to the Lord who shone forth from thee, we receive from him forgiveness of sins and the riches of his great mercy.
